alternatesIfResolutionRejected.rule: If any proposed resolution for HV2F-100/142/149 is not approved, replace it, in order, with these unambiguous non-assertions so the set stays at 24 and labels are still fixed before any call.

labelDisputeRegister.rule: Original gold labels are NOT edited and the blind result is NOT re-scored. Disputed cases are excluded from the pilot unless a proposed resolution is approved.

materialityDisputes.text: The vendor claims 'the certificate was delivered in June,' but we have not confirmed that.
materialityDisputes.reason: The quoted clause is correctly non-adopted, but 'we have not confirmed that' is a separate checkable assertion about the current verification state.

materialityDisputes.text: يؤكد المورد أن «الشهادة سُلِّمت في يونيو»، لكننا لم نتحقق من ذلك بعد.
materialityDisputes.reason: Same structure as HV2F-100: 'لكننا لم نتحقق من ذلك بعد' asserts the current unverified state.

materialityDisputes.text: The vendor insists «تم التسليم في يونيو» — still unverified.
materialityDisputes.reason: 'still unverified' asserts the current verification state.

materialityDisputes.text: ذكر ممثل المورد أن الدفعة سُلِّمت، دون أن يقدم مستندًا.
materialityDisputes.reason: 'دون أن يقدم مستندًا' asserts that no supporting document was provided — checkable against evidence records.

materialityDisputes.text: 'The penalty was already paid,' according to their account manager — treating that as unverified for now.
materialityDisputes.reason: 'treating that as unverified' is a handling stance that implies no verification record; arguably a current-state assertion.

materialityDisputes.text: بحسب مدير الحساب: «الغرامة سُددت بالفعل» — ونتعامل معها كمعلومة غير موثقة.
materialityDisputes.reason: Same as HV2F-101: 'نتعامل معها كمعلومة غير موثقة' implies an undocumented current state.

materialityDisputes.text: لو كان لدينا تأكيد على استلام الشهادة، لأغلقنا الفجوة الآن.
materialityDisputes.reason: A counterfactual conditional conventionally conveys that there is no confirmation and the gap is open — a current state carried by implicature rather than stated outright.

materialityDisputes.text: تمام، وصلت — شكرًا على سرعة الإنجاز.
materialityDisputes.reason: 'وصلت' (it arrived) and 'سرعة الإنجاز' (quick completion) may assert receipt or completion; the referent is unclear.

materialityDisputes.text: The draft minutes quote Legal as saying the clause 'looks acceptable.'
materialityDisputes.reason: Legal's view is not adopted, but the answer does assert what the minutes contain — checkable against that document.

materialityDisputes.text: ورد في محضر الاجتماع أن الشؤون القانونية ترى الصياغة «مقبولة مبدئيًا».
materialityDisputes.reason: Same as HV2F-102: asserts the content of the minutes.

budget.attemptsPolicy: one attempt per case; no automatic retry; a transport or parse failure is recorded as INCOMPLETE for that case, never silently resent

budget.enforcement: abort the run at the first request that would exceed any limit; usage is taken from the provider's returned usage fields, not from estimates

rawResponseCapture.requestsFile: reports/<timestamp>-reviewer-pilot-requests.json — exact request bodies with sha256 each, built and committed BEFORE any call
rawResponseCapture.rawFile: reports/<timestamp>-reviewer-pilot-raw.jsonl — one line per attempt: caseId, requestSha256, provider, model, startedAt, durationMs, httpStatus, providerRequestId if returned, usage exactly as returned, rawResponseText verbatim, parseOk, parseError
rawResponseCapture.order: raw file committed BEFORE scoring; scoring reads only the committed raw file and this manifest, so it is reproducible without new calls
rawResponseCapture.secrets: no API key, header or auth value is written to any file

comparison.spanMatching: a reviewer unit matches a reference unit when, after removing diacritics, punctuation and extra whitespace, the reference span is contained in the reviewer span or they overlap by at least half the reference span's length
comparison.caseVerdictAggregation: over the reviewer's ASSERTED units: any CONTRADICTED → CONTRADICTED; else any REVIEWER_UNCERTAIN → UNCERTAIN (counted separately, never a pass); else any INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE → INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; else SUPPORTED. No ASSERTED unit → NON_ASSERTION

errorClasses.E1_FALSE_PASS: reviewer SUPPORTED where the reference is CONTRADICTED or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE (dangerous direction)
errorClasses.E2_MISSED_CONTRADICTION: reviewer INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE where the reference is CONTRADICTED
errorClasses.E3_FALSE_ALARM: reviewer CONTRADICTED or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE where the reference is SUPPORTED
errorClasses.E4_OMISSION: a required reference ASSERTED unit not matched by any reviewer ASSERTED unit
errorClasses.E5_SPURIOUS_ASSERTION: reviewer ASSERTED unit where the reference has a NON_ASSERTION unit or no units
errorClasses.E6_INVENTED_REFERENCE: a sourceRef that does not resolve to a path in the supplied sources; that unit's verdict is voided to REVIEWER_UNCERTAIN
errorClasses.E7_UNCERTAIN: REVIEWER_UNCERTAIN on any unit, reported separately
errorClasses.E8_INCOMPLETE: transport failure, non-JSON output or schema violation; the case is INCOMPLETE, not scored as pass

comparison.reported: case-level confusion (reference × reviewer), unit-level confusion, every error by class with exact span, results per group and per locale, coverage omissions, usage and cost

proposedFeasibilitySignals.status: PROPOSED — requires approval before the run; these are go/no-go signals for a larger study, not acceptance of the reviewer
goToLargerStudyOnlyIf: E4_OMISSION = 0 on the dangerous cases and at most 1 overall

hardChecksIndependence: The existing deterministic checks (authorization, tenant isolation, citation identity/scope, database effects, idempotency, actual action states, supported numerical calculations) are unchanged and remain authoritative. A semantic reviewer verdict can never override a deterministic security failure, its output carries no confidence score, and any source reference it cites is validated mechanically. This calibration pilot has no tool traces or database effects, so those checks are not exercised here.
